title: agave parryi subsp. neomexicana
intro: Agave parryi subsp. neomexicana, commonly known as New Mexico agave or Neomexican agave, is a succulent plant species belonging to the Agave genus. The health benefits of Agave parryi subsp. neomexicana are largely attributed to its traditional use in folk medicine for treating various ailments, including wounds, burns, and skin irritations, due to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are associated with its ability to modulate immune responses, promote wound healing, and exhibit analgesic and antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents of Agave parryi subsp. neomexicana include saponins, flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
